title: The Stock Market Is Walking Into Something It Can’t Stop
speaker: Tom and Mike (StockedUp hosts)

macro_themes.view: Houthi threats to Saudi oil facilities and Iran war preparations keep energy supply disruption worsening.
Record-low correlation between equal-weight and cap-weight S&P shows mega-caps distorting the index; focus on sectors instead of SPY.
S&P earnings yield is 1.5 points below the 10-year yield, signalling stretched valuations.
CXMT memory progress hit Micron, Samsung and Korea; AI valuations make downside risk-reward favorable over weeks to months.
CPI expected to rise to 3.6% y/y; a print above 3.6% would be the big risk.
